assistantMessage.text:
Actual visibility/authorization enforcement sites:

- Direct memo read (`GetMemo`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67,341-368` — rejects anonymous non-public reads and non-owner private reads; also checks a parent memo before returning a comment.
- Memo listing (`ListMemos`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:178-227` — forces anonymous results to `PUBLIC`; authenticated users receive their own memos plus `PUBLIC`/`PROTECTED`.
- Memo-comment listing — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:136-161,175-181` — first authorizes the parent read, then filters child comments to the caller’s visibility set.
- Memo-attachment metadata listing — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:200-240` — blocks anonymous non-public reads and foreign private-memo reads before listing attachment metadata.
- Memo-reaction listing — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:15-57` — applies the same public/authenticated/private-owner gate before exposing reactions.
- Memo-relation endpoint — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:93-146` — supplies a visibility-dependent `MemoFilter` to both incoming and outgoing relation queries, preventing inaccessible related memos from being returned.
- Embedded relation expansion — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:171-287` — filters both directions of relations while converting memos, so a visible memo does not disclose an inaccessible linked memo.
- Generic attachment RPC (`GetAttachment`) — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:242-260,419-455` — resolves the attachment’s memo and applies its visibility rule; unlinked files are creator/admin only.
- Explore RSS — `server/router/rss/rss.go:72-108` — public HTTP feed queries only normal, public, non-comment memos.
- Per-user RSS — `server/router/rss/rss.go:111-159` — independently applies the same `PUBLIC`-only filter for user feeds.
- Attachment binary file server — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:131-165,649-704` — authorizes `/file/attachments/...` via linked-memo visibility, instance anonymous-access policy, authenticated identity, or a valid memo-specific share token.
- Memo-share read path — `server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go:151-207` — allows otherwise non-public memo retrieval only after validating an existing, unexpired opaque share token; archived/missing targets remain hidden.
- SSE memo-event delivery — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:112-143` — suppresses private-memo events for everyone except the owner/admin; visibility is intentionally server-only (`json:"-"`) at lines 31-33.
- Mention-notification delivery — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:56-89,109-135` — skips notifications to users who cannot access a private memo or its private parent, avoiding a visibility leak through inbox/email delivery.

Not counted as authorization: `web/src/pages/Explore.tsx:11-22` requests a narrower visibility list for UX, but it is client-controlled and the backend `ListMemos` filter above remains authoritative. MCP is likewise not separate enforcement: it replays requests through the in-process API router (`server/router/mcp/adapter.go:27-43`).
